name: L-Sit
summary: An advanced isometric calisthenics hold where the body is suspended on the hands with the legs held straight and parallel to the floor.

setup: Sit on the floor with your legs fully extended straight in front of you and feet together.
Place your palms flat on the floor beside your hips, fingers pointing forward or slightly outward.
Lock your elbows and draw your shoulders away from your ears.
steps: Press aggressively through your palms to depress your scapulae and lift your hips off the ground.
Simultaneously contract your abdominals and hip flexors to lift your straight legs parallel to the floor, forming a 90-degree 'L' shape with your torso.
Point your toes, maintain fully locked knees, and hold the suspended position for the target duration.
Lower your hips and heels smoothly back to the floor under control.
instructions.breathing: Take shallow, controlled breaths into your upper chest while maintaining continuous abdominal and hip tension throughout the hold.

common_faults.fault: Bending the knees to decrease hip flexor leverage.
common_faults.correction: Squeeze your quadriceps hard to maintain full knee lockout; scale to a tuck L-sit if necessary.

common_faults.fault: Shrugging the shoulders up toward the ears, losing scapular depression.
common_faults.correction: Actively press downward through your hands to create maximal distance between your shoulders and ears.

common_faults.fault: Allowing the hips to drop below hand level or dragging the heels.
common_faults.correction: Focus on driving your pelvis forward slightly and actively pulling the thighs toward your torso with your hip flexors.

precautions: Warm up the wrists and shoulders thoroughly before performing floor support holds.
